meta.notes: D1 and D2 are both quadcopters, so we keep D2 on standby to meet the rule of having one quadcopter on standby. M1 is the most capable in terms of endurance and payload, so we assign it the tasks that require the robotic arm and a larger payload. M2 and M3 are assigned tasks that require the robotic arm but have smaller payloads. T4 and T8 have tight deadlines, so they are prioritized early in the plan.
